_comment: Affine from the 919x792 SVG pixel space of campus-map.svg to WGS84 Web Mercator.
merc_x = cx[0]*px + cx[1]*py + cx[2];  merc_y = cy[0]*px + cy[1]*py + cy[2]
Fitted by tools/fit-georef.py on name-matched building centroids; see docs/BUILD_PLAN_3D.md 1.1.
The map is effectively north-up (0.07 deg) and near-isotropic (1.639 vs 1.625 m/px, 0.9%),
so px axes and true east/north agree to within a rounding error at campus scale.

enuOrigin._comment: Local metric frame for the 3D scene: +x east, +z south (three.js y-up), metres.
